scope: Isolated in-memory source/worker/target-fit/review/UV processing. No production API or model readiness change.

source.rgb: EXIF-corrected RGB from the preprocessing owner, at most16000000 pixels
source.landmarks: project_vertices of the source raw fit using its ordered68x3 coordinate indices
source.alignment: Existing align_ffhq256; reflected context is not observed texture and its inverse is not generated-image correspondence
source.geometry: Original source raw full fit and fixed canonical frame; generated fit only projects its own generated RGB
source.binding: Detector/reconstructor/SAM manifest SHA256 and common UV asset SHA256, plus actual ordered topology/UV/array fingerprints
source.serialization: Versioned bounded JSON/base64 arrays with fixed dtype and shape; no pickle/ZIP/NPZ object loading
source.api_source_age: Preserve validated SourceAge. Filename labels and generation conditions never fill unknown/null.

condition_research.semantics: An explicit SAM integer condition, not an absolute biological-age prediction or source-age reset
condition_research.staging: Bounded immutable bytes in existing AssetCache, fixed TTL/LRU and opaque metadata handles
condition_research.same_source_condition_stage_hit: Reuse the unexpired staged PNG/fit without a second SAM/refit call

absolute_age_adapter.unknown_source_age: SOURCE_AGE_REQUIRED before generation or cache bypass
absolute_age_adapter.exact_source_age: Return original GLB/texture/shape bytes before integer generation checks; no rounding
absolute_age_adapter.other_fractional_age: INTEGER_AGE_REQUIRED; display interpolation remains a separate previously implemented path
absolute_age_adapter.coordinator: Reuse existing AgingCoordinator/AgingSessionCache. Do not change their source-age checks or production app.

target_review.masks: Explicit same-size L PNG0/255 allowed and occluded, disjoint; unspecified areas remain ineligible
target_review.missing_or_reassigned: REVIEW_REQUIRED; retain bounded staged bytes and publish no SessionResult
target_review.forbidden_fallback: No automatic all-allowed mask, old nominal-condition mask reuse, source valid-mask reuse, or unknown-color filling
target_review.provider: Synchronous local hash-bound review lookup or explicit staged review; it grants no independent quality acceptance

registration.sampling: register_generated_texture on the target full expression fit, target projection/ROI and reviewed mask
registration.mesh: build_static_mesh on the original source raw fit; source shape/canonical geometry/ordered triangles/common UV unchanged
registration.output: SessionResult kind sam_registered_uv with generated/review/model/condition provenance; static_fallback shape
registration.unknown_rgba: Exactly zero, no color completion or boundary blending

resources.native_admission: Single flight covers SAM and CPU refit/registration until actual completion
resources.cancellation: Shield and drain native CPU work; finally await worker.wait_idle before releasing source/admission
resources.stage_expiry: Expired handles cannot register, expired or abandoned work cannot become a cached successful result
resources.ownership: Processor owns worker and stage store; detector/reconstructor callback model ownership remains the caller
resources.shutdown: Cancellation of a close waiter must not cancel actual cleanup; wait for worker process exit before CUDA lease release

validation.synthetic: Real PNG/GLB/FFHQ/UV components plus controlled fake generation and actual stdio fixture, clearly labelled synthetic
validation.real: One development source with API age unknown: source preparation, explicit integer generation, target own refit, REVIEW_REQUIRED, explicit reviewed registration, stage hit and cache/TTL/shutdown evidence
validation.known_source_live_scope: Only after user provides a real source age or a qualified estimated age; never substitute filename age or assistant-filled value
validation.errors: No face, multiple faces, wrong hashes, unavailable review and resource failures retained with public-safe codes
